title: Air-Fluidized Bed

criteria.span: The patient has a stage 3 (full thickness tissue loss) or stage 4 (deep tissue destruction) pressure sore;

criteria.text: Bedridden or chair bound from severely limited mobility
criteria.span: The patient is bedridden or chair bound as a result of severely limited mobility;

criteria.text: Would require institutionalization without the bed
criteria.span: In the absence of an air-fluidized bed, the patient would require institutionalization;

criteria.text: Conservative treatment for at least one month without progression toward healing (may include documented institutional time)
criteria.span: This course of treatment must have been at least one month in duration without progression toward wound healing.

criteria.text: Conservative treatment included a Group II specialized support surface
criteria.span: Use of a specialized support surface (Group II) designed to reduce pressure and shear forces on healing ulcers and to prevent new ulcer formation;
A trained adult caregiver is available to assist the patient with activities of daily living

criteria.text: Not covered with coexisting pulmonary disease
criteria.span: The patient has coexisting pulmonary disease

criteria.text: Not covered if wet soaks or moist dressings are not protected by an occlusive covering
criteria.span: The patient requires treatment with wet soaks or moist wound dressings that are not protected with an impervious covering such as plastic wrap or other occlusive material;

criteria.text: Written order from the attending physician furnished to the supplier before delivery
criteria.span: Payment for this covered item may only be made if the written order from the attending physician is furnished to the supplier prior to the delivery of the equipment.

criteria.text: Exception: institutional time may count toward the conservative month if documented
criteria.span: This month of prerequisite conservative treatment may include some period in an institution as long as there is documentation available to verify that the necessary conservative treatment has been rendered.

criteria.text: Exception: wet-to-dry debridement continuing beyond 30 days does not preclude coverage
criteria.span: Use of wet-to-dry dressings for wound debridement, begun during the period of conservative treatment and which continue beyond 30 days, will not preclude coverage of air-fluidized bed.

notes: Exceptions tested: part of the prerequisite month of conservative treatment may be in an institution if documented; wet-to-dry debridement continuing beyond 30 days does not preclude coverage (wet-to-dry does not need an occlusive covering), unlike moist dressings/wet soaks without an occlusive covering.
